summary: E2E frontend testing of Quick Start onboarding panel (Inicio rápido) completed. All functional scenarios pass: role-based visibility (admin sees, doctor hidden), 14 steps rendered with all features active, progress text/bar, toggle/untoggle with persistence across reload (PUT /api/clinic/quick-start), navigation with ?tab= support for team→members and roles→roles, plus go-patients & go-agenda, complete-all shows banner, dismiss hides panel and persists across reload, and restore from Configuración › Datos re-shows the panel. Panel state remains at clinic level.
critical_code_review_comments: QuickStartPanel.persist() has stale closure risk: rollback uses `completed` captured at call time which is fine, but the useCallback deps are disabled via eslint-disable. Not blocking.
On network failure the fetch handler sets dismissed=true (fail-closed) which silently hides the panel forever for that render — user has no error toast. Consider a retry or explicit error state.
STEPS array is defined at module scope: OK for i18n hardcoded ES, but if i18n added later, titles/descs will not react to locale changes.
